changes.what: Guard layer (ours). Added patch 'sliver': (a) planar copies whose bboxes overlap/touch with a sliver overlap 1e-8 < d <= 5e-4 mm are refused; (b) SUM CHECK: when every pair of planar copies is provably apart (gap > 1e-3 mm) the join result must equal the sum of the copies' own volumes to 1e-9, else refused. Added student sentences for the sum check and for a refused draft (the generic fallback no longer names the kernel and is no longer used for draft). Header documents both thresholds and that they were chosen after seeing fuzz data.
Two missing script-layer rules (repeat/repeatAround/mirror of a pocket whose copies overlap) found by the new make-rows lint: the shipped text named brep-rs and FreeCAD.
'sliver' added to ALL_PATCHES (default on; PM_OFF=sliver is the negative control).
New --mode=sliver and --mode=aligned (closed-form oracle, no OCCT), 'sliver' in the patch list, mode/sliverGuard in the summary.
NEW. Truck-alone run (closed-form oracle) of the large-count cases the OCCT oracle cannot hold in 1500 MB (box count 200/1000/1001/1e5, ring 1001).
NEW. Merges the per-chunk pm-run outputs into pm-results.json + pm-results.stamp.json (wasm sha256, patches, budgets, cap, storedNotReplayed, changedVsPrevious).

Rows builder. Repaired for the current inputs (SENTENCE_NOTE and the round-5 block that was missing); new rows: near-coincident repeat copies (snap), sliver overlap, copies a hair apart / sum check, near-coincident cuts, closed hollow (refused), open hollow, rounded whole shapes; rewrote the time-limit, count, sub-micron and provenance rows from live data; global lint: every refusalSentence is plain (no kernel/engine word, no id) and every refused row has one.
Regenerated by LIVE chunked runs on the pinned wasm (sha256 9f21ccfe...), 526 of 534 cases fresh; the previous file is kept as pm-results-round4-stored.json.

rigNotesForRIGmd: patterns-mirror round 5 (fix round 1): the whole suite is run in CHUNKS under the 1500 MB cap, one pm-run.mjs process per chunk: `systemd-run --user --scope -q -p MemoryMax=1500M -p MemorySwapMax=0 timeout 900 bun contract/pm-run.mjs --out=<scratch>/<chunk> --only=<id,id|prefix*>`; a single process over r4-* or the 1000-copy cases is killed by the cap (exit 137). Merge: `python3 contract/pm-merge-chunks.py <outdir> <chunkdir> [<chunkdir>...]` (writes pm-results.json + pm-results.stamp.json; cases without a fresh record keep the stored one and are listed in storedNotReplayed); `--concat <file> <dirs/files>` for the negative-control files. Negative controls: PM_OFF=snap (--only='r4-snap-*' groups -> pm-results-snapoff.json), PM_TR=asis for the reversed/taper cases (-> pm-results-asis-oracle.json), PM_BUDGET_MS=3000 (-> pm-results-budget-demo.json), PM_TR=r2 PM_BUDGET=off on the r3 cases (-> pm3-results-r2translator.json), PM_OFF=fused (-> pm3-results-fusedoff.json). Fuzz (no OCCT): `bun contract/pm-snap-fuzz.mjs [--mode=mixed|sliver|aligned] --n=N --seed=S --out=f.json`, PM_OFF=snap|sliver for the controls. Count cases on truck alone: `bun contract/pm-count-truck.mjs --only=<id> --out=f.json`. pkill -f matches the calling shell; do not use it. Rows: `python3 contract/pm-make-rows.py`.
